offering_description.value: Parsons provides engineering, cybersecurity, and mission systems integration to defense and intelligence agencies. It also designs transportation and other infrastructure and manages construction and remediation programs for public agencies and private owners. It delivers this work through project teams that develop software, integrate equipment, and oversee work in the field.

primary_products.value: mission command and control systems; cybersecurity software; counter-drone systems; traffic management software

primary_services.value: defense and space systems engineering and integration; cybersecurity and intelligence support; infrastructure design and engineering; program and construction management; environmental remediation

customer_segment.value: B2G: Defense and intelligence agencies, civilian government agencies, transportation authorities, and municipalities; B2B: Defense prime contractors, private infrastructure owners, and real estate developers

end_markets.value: defense and intelligence; space; transportation; urban development; environmental remediation

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Mission systems, technical support, infrastructure design, construction oversight, and remediation under fixed-price, cost-reimbursement, or time-and-materials contracts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Combines engineering labor, software, and equipment to deliver defense systems and infrastructure projects for agencies and private owners; software / platform: Develops and integrates mission and traffic management software for defense agencies and transportation operators

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, Canada, and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Defense and intelligence technology, transportation and urban infrastructure engineering, and environmental remediation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Competitive government bids and direct contracting with public agencies and private infrastructure owners; partners / resellers: Teaming agreements and subcontracts with defense and infrastructure prime contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Federal acquisition rules and classified-work requirements for defense contracts, plus engineering licensure and environmental rules for infrastructure projects

notes: The extent to which Parsons sells its software and systems separately from project contracts is unclear.
